key.name: hud-enabled
key.description: When true, the mate-hud-daemon is expected to be running and will show a searchable menu on shortcut activation.

key.name: hud-shortcut
key.description: HUD shortcut string. In internal shortcut mode this is intended for modifier-only shortcuts such as "Alt_L" or "<Alt>Super_L". For full accelerators such as "<Alt>space", use MATE Control Center shortcut handling.

key.name: hud-use-system-shortcut
key.summary: Use system shortcut instead of internal key grab
key.description: When true, MATE Control Center handles the shortcut and the daemon does not grab keys internally. This is the safe default for full accelerators such as "<Alt>space".

key.name: hud-history-max
key.description: Number of most-recently-used menu items remembered per application WM class.

key.name: hud-attach-to
key.summary: Attach HUD to monitor, window, or applet
key.description: Controls HUD placement. Use "window" for the active application window, "monitor" for its monitor workarea, or "applet" to open beside the global menu applet like a dropdown.

key.name: hud-location
key.description: Anchor position for the HUD within the selected rectangle. Valid values are northwest, north, northeast, west, center, east, southwest, south, and southeast.

key.name: hud-applet-x
key.summary: Global menu applet screen X coordinate

key.name: hud-applet-y
key.summary: Global menu applet screen Y coordinate
